1.

Art thou in distress, Hast thou no support, Dost thou feel forsaken, The Lord is rich, Ever the same, Never is His door shut.

2.

Rich in grace, He knows a way, Tell Him what ails thee; Great or small, Only tell Him, He will share His help with thee.

3.

Though many a friend May yet fail thee, The Lord is the sure Rock. Faithful He is, Holds thee dear, On Him thou canst build.

4.

Help He has, Ready and near For thee in the right time. The day of trial, With God’s good pleasure, Shall shortly pass away.

5.

Only take courage, The Lord is good, He acts in love. The bread of tears, The hardest distress, He turns into joy.

6.

Jesus, Thy name The safest haven Is in all changes; Comfort in distress, Life in death, The light even at the grave.
